title: Trace-assisted latency correlator panel by model & route (streaming vs non-streaming)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: build a unified dashboard panel that correlates latencies (p50/p95/p99) with tracing signals and request metadata, split by model and route and with an explicit streaming vs non-streaming toggle. This panel should make it easy for on-call and SRE to identify whether tail latency is due to runtime (servepath), network, kernel scheduling, or downstream IO, and to quickly jump into traces and raw logs.

Scope and data sources:
- Metrics: percentiles (p50/p95/p99) from the existing timeseries pipeline (Prometheus/StatsD -> metrics-collector -> warehouse). Add tags for model, route, io_mode (streaming/non-streaming), model_family, sequence_length_bucket, and concurrency_bucket.
- Tracing: instrument trace hooks on servepath ingress and egress; ensure traces include model_variant, route, batching_id, and kernel_hint. Implement a lightweight sampling policy: full traces for p99 events, 1% sampling for p95 bucket, 0.1% for p50.
- Logs: enrich request logs with latency components (request_received_ts, queued_ms, runtime_ms, kernel_ms, kvcache_hit, downstream_ms). Parse via existing log pipeline and surface as dimensions.

Deliverables:
- New dashboard panel in Console that supports: model and route selectors, streaming toggle, percentile selector (p50/p95/p99), time window quick filters, and a heatmap of latency by sequence_length vs concurrency.
- Drilldowns to trace list filtered to the selected cohort and a direct link to an exploded trace view.
- Backend metrics schema changes and a lightweight migration plan for historical rollups.

Trade-offs and decisions considered:
- Full tracing for all requests is too costly; use percentile-driven adaptive sampling (see above).
- Granular tagging increases metrics cardinality; mitigate with sequence_length_bucket and concurrency_bucket instead of raw values.
- Immediate rollout to hosted tenants will be opt-in behind a feature flag to avoid metric cost spikes.

Acceptance criteria, instrumentation, and rollout steps are in acceptance_criteria below.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard panel added to Console observability -> Latency with selectors for model, route, time window, and io_mode
Percentile lines show correct values for p50/p95/p99 within +/- 3% of query over raw timeseries for test dataset
Streaming toggle splits the view and updates percentiles and heatmap within 2s of selection
Trace hook sampling implemented: full traces for p99 events, 1% sampling for p95 cohort, 0.1% for p50 cohort
Logs pipeline emits enriched latency components for each request and dashboard drilldown links to log search
Metrics cardinality constrained using defined buckets (sequence_length_bucket, concurrency_bucket) and validated against staging quotas
Feature-flagged rollout to hosted API customers; opt-in enabled and monitored for cost impact for 72 hours before broader enablement
work_notes: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with SRE, runtime, and metrics teams. Agreed on adaptive sampling approach for traces; runtime will add batch_id to trace context.
2026-02-22: Metrics schema proposal reviewed by metrics infra (see link). Decided to use 8 sequence_length buckets and 5 concurrency buckets to balance resolution vs cardinality.
2026-02-28: Prototype panel wireframe completed (Figma). UX asks for streaming toggle to preserve the same y-axis scale across modes — implemented as option in config.
2026-03-03: Runtime PR opened to emit latency component tags and kernel_hint on trace root; awaiting code review (GH PR #4217).

2026-03-07: Metrics pipeline update deployed to staging; verifying bucketed counts and rollup correctness. Observed a 12% increase in metric ingestion in staging — working with infra to throttle label cardinality during canary.
2026-03-09: QA: compared percentile calc from new dashboard vs batch offline calc over 7 days of test traffic; discrepancies under 2.5% for p95/p99, 1.1% for p50.
2026-03-10: Ready for canary behind feature flag — plan: 48-hour canary on low-traffic tenants, monitor metric cardinality and cost.
implementation_plan: Instrument trace hooks in runtime (span root tags: model_variant, route, batching_id, kernel_hint)
Update metrics emitter to include io_mode tag and bucketing for sequence_length and concurrency
Extend logs parser to surface latency components and kvcache flags
Build dashboard panel frontend and wire to metrics queries and trace links
Deploy to staging, validate percentiles vs offline batch calculations
Canary behind feature flag for selected hosted tenants, monitor cardinality/cost, then roll out
